text:
Omar: FYI — Daniel Chen (eng, frontend) submitted a resignation today. Last working day will be 2026-04-10. Please help coordinate access cutoff, benefits/Cobra, equipment return, and an exit interview.

Julie: Thanks Omar. Julie (People Ops) here — we’ll own the exit interview scheduling and benefits notices. Can Payroll confirm final pay timing and PTO payout rules? Also tagging IT for deprovision.

Payroll: Payroll here — final payroll cycle after last day is 2026-04-15 run. Accrued PTO payout will be included if termination code "TERM_RESIGN" is submitted by 4/12. Please confirm termination date and whether there's any outstanding expense reimbursements.

Isha: Isha (IT-Ops) — noted. Can you confirm Daniel's primary username (email) and whether he has any shared admin SSH keys or personal GCP projects?

Omar: Email is daniel.chen@redwood.com. He has access to GitHub (team frontend), GCP prod viewer, Datadog read, and an Okta admin group he was briefly added to for a rollout (should remove).

Isha: Thanks. I'll queue deprovisioning for 2026-04-11 09:00 PT — deprovision order: okta->github->gcp->datadog. Please review this quick checklist and add anything missing:

```
# Offboard checklist (example)
- Disable Okta account
- Revoke GitHub org membership + transfer any owned repos
- Remove GCP IAM bindings, disable service accounts created by user
- Revoke Datadog API keys
- Collect company laptop + peripherals (or schedule ship label)
```

Isha: If someone needs emergency access after cutover, create a temporary cross-team request and we can whitelist short-term.

Ben: Can we assign ownership for Daniel's active PRs and the feature branch he’s been working on? I can take over the main PRs, but need a quick knowledge transfer doc or 30-min walkthrough before 4/9.

Daniel Chen: Happy to do a 30-min handoff call. I’ll publish a short runbook and the list of open PRs by EOD tomorrow. For laptop return — remote pickup preferred. I live OOS so please send a prepaid label.

Julie: Noted on pickup. People Ops will email Daniel the equipment return options and pre-paid label instructions. Also, COBRA/benefits: health coverage remains active through 04/30/2026 (end of calendar month of termination). COBRA election packet will be emailed on 04/11 and he’ll have 60 days to elect continuation coverage.

Daniel Chen: Thanks — can someone confirm 401(k) vesting and my equity exercise window?

Julie: 401(k) vesting follows plan docs; any employer contributions are vested per schedule — HR will send the vesting report. For equity, standard policy is 90 days to exercise vested options post-termination for voluntary resignations. I'll loop in Legal to confirm if there's any different clause on Daniel's grant.

Legal: Quick note from Legal — we see Daniel's grant uses the standard 90-day exercise window. If he has questions about conversion or ISO/NSO tax treatment, we can set up a call.

Omar: One ask — please hold a copy of his personal email contact in case we need to reach out about admin tasks after termination (small things like stock paperwork). Julie, can People Ops confirm the contact retention policy?

Julie: We retain a single contact email for 12 months for payroll/benefits/eq admin only. We’ll collect preferred address in the offboarding form.

Isha: Created ticket OFF-4382 for IT deprovisioning and asset return. Command we’ll run on 2026-04-11: `deprovision --user daniel.chen@redwood.com --when 2026-04-11T09:00Z --assets-collect`. Adding Omar and Ben as approvers.

Payroll: Also confirm: any outstanding expenses? Omar, please confirm expense reports submitted by 4/9 to be included in final payout.

Omar: He has one pending expense (conference travel) — will approve today.

Ben: I'll book the 30-min handoff for 4/08 14:00 PT and add notes to the repo. Daniel — prefer Zoom or Google Meet?

Daniel Chen: Zoom is fine. I’ll post the runbook and the PR list by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:

Julie: Scheduling exit interview — options: 4/12 10am PT or 4/13 3pm PT. Daniel, which works?

Daniel Chen: 4/12 10am PT works.

Julie: Great — exit interview booked. Daniel, People Ops will send the COBRA packet and benefits wrap-up email on 04/11 and the equipment return label. IT-Ops will start deprovision 04/11 09:00 PT after confirmation. Payroll confirmed final run on 04/15. Anything else folks?

Ben: Please make sure repo ownership transfer is done before 4/09 so CI isn't blocked.

Isha: Will prioritize repo transfer after okta revoke step. If any repos are org-owned, we'll transfer admin to @Ben.

Omar: Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Daniel Chen: Thanks team — really appreciate the support.
